name: goojara
description: Simple bash / node script to extract Goojara / Wootly video urls. Handles the random advert redirects and just returns the video url.

scripts.path:linux:
mkdir -p ~/.local/bin; echo "#!/usr/bin/env sh

bash $(pwd)/link.sh "'$@' | tee ~/.local/bin/goojara; chmod +x ~/.local/bin/goojara
scripts.path:docker:
mkdir -p ~/.local/bin; echo "#!/usr/bin/env sh

bash $(pwd)/link.docker.sh "'$@' | tee ~/.local/bin/goojara; chmod +x ~/.local/bin/goojara

author: Richard Muvirimi <richard@tyganeutronics.com>
